answer: A zephyr moves fast but leaves nothing behind; sybils are the same, so make entry leave a deposit. Each agent posts a refundable stake that vests back slowly, and only while its grading record stays clean — a single confirmed junk grade freezes the next tranche. Like a vine, good behavior compounds into full refund; like a river, bad behavior is carried away with the stake. Farming a hundred sockpuppets then means locking a hundred stakes that honest grading can never release.
